 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 80
skinparam ranksep 90
skinparam Padding 6

' Deixa as linhas e bordas mais escuras e nítidas no draw.io
skinparam ArrowColor #222222
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.6
skinparam ArrowFontColor #111111
skinparam ArrowFontSize 12
skinparam ClassBorderColor #222222
skinparam ClassBorderThickness 1.5

package \"insights.application\" {

 class DailyInsightsService {
 - storeCatalog : StoreCatalog
 - salesHistory : ConfirmedSalesHistory
 - productCatalog : ProductCatalog
 - recipeCatalog : RecipeCatalog
 - stockSnapshot : StockSnapshot
 - forecastWeeks : int
 - minSamplesHigh : int
 - minSamplesMedium : int
 - defaultExpiryWindowDays : int
 - defaultHorizonDays : int
 + getDailyInsights(date : LocalDate, expiryWindowDays : Integer, horizonDays : Integer) : DailyInsightsOutput
 }
}

package \"insights.domain\" {

 package \"ports (catálogos e consultas)\" {
 interface StoreCatalog {
 + getDefaultStore() : Optional<StoreRef>
 }

 interface ProductCatalog {
 + findActiveProducts() : List<CatalogProduct>
 }

 interface ConfirmedSalesHistory {
 + findDailyQuantities(from : LocalDateTime, to : LocalDateTime) : List<DailySoldQuantity>
 }

 interface RecipeCatalog {
 + findAll() : List<RecipeLine>
 }

 interface StockSnapshot {
 + findActiveItems() : List<StockItemSnapshot>
 + findOpenLots() : List<StockLotSnapshot>
 }
 }

 package \"model (snapshots de leitura)\" {
 class CatalogProduct <<record>> {
 + id : Long
 + name : String
 + price : BigDecimal
 }

 class DailySoldQuantity <<record>> {
 + date : LocalDate
 + productId : Long
 + quantity : int
 }

 class RecipeLine <<record>> {
 + productId : Long
 + stockItemId : Long
 + quantityPerUnit : int
 }

 class StockItemSnapshot <<record>> {
 + id : Long
 + name : String
 + unit : String
 + currentQuantity : int
 + minimumStock : int
 }

 class StockLotSnapshot <<record>> {
 + lotId : Long
 + stockItemId : Long
 + quantity : int
 + expiresAt : LocalDate
 }
 }

 package \"calculators (domain services)\" {
 class DemandForecastCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} METHOD : String = \"WEEKDAY_AVERAGE\"
 + {static} forecast(products : List<CatalogProduct>, sampleDates : List<LocalDate>, history : List<DailySoldQuantity>, minHigh : int, minMedium : int) : List<ProductDemand>
 }

 enum ForecastConfidence {
 HIGH
 MEDIUM
 LOW
 }

 class PurchaseSuggestionCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} suggest(demand : List<ProductDemand>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>, items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, horizonDays : int) : List<PurchaseSuggestion>
 }

 class CriticalStockCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} find(items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>) : List<CriticalStock>
 }

 class ExpiryPromotionCalculator <<domain service>> {
 + {static} calculate(targetDate : LocalDate, expiryWindowDays : int, lots : List<StockLotSnapshot>, items : List<StockItemSnapshot>, recipes : List<RecipeLine>, demand : List<ProductDemand>) : Result
 }

 DemandForecastCalculator -down-> ForecastConfidence : classifica >
 DemandForecastCalculator -right-> PurchaseSuggestionCalculator : fornece demanda >
 PurchaseSuggestionCalculator -[hidden]right-> CriticalStockCalculator
 CriticalStockCalculator -[hidden]right-> ExpiryPromotionCalculator
 }
}

' Relacionamentos Application -> Ports
DailyInsightsService -down-> StoreCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> ProductCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> ConfirmedSalesHistory
DailyInsightsService -down-> RecipeCatalog
DailyInsightsService -down-> StockSnapshot

' Relacionamentos diretos e alinhados verticalmente Ports -> Snapshots
ProductCatalog -down-> CatalogProduct : retorna >
ConfirmedSalesHistory -down-> DailySoldQuantity : retorna >
RecipeCatalog -down-> RecipeLine : retorna >
StockSnapshot -down-> StockItemSnapshot : retorna >
StockSnapshot -down-> StockLotSnapshot : retorna >

' Alinhamento vertical dos Calculators abaixo dos Snapshots sem cruzar linhas
CatalogProduct -[hidden]down-> DemandForecastCalculator
DailySoldQuantity -[hidden]down-> PurchaseSuggestionCalculator
RecipeLine -[hidden]down-> CriticalStockCalculator
StockItemSnapshot -[hidden]down-> ExpiryPromotionCalculator

@enduml
